I am an old man now, 72 years. My back is not what it was, but my son-in-law helps with the heavy work and I still walk my 9 mu every morning. Wheat and maize, wheat and maize — same as my father, same as his father. I did not finish school but I have seen 50 harvests on this land, so I know what she wants.

**For my wheat (9 mu, winter):**

I plant around Cold Dew, early October, after I get the maize off. I buy improved seed from the agricultural supply shop in town — everyone uses 济麦 or 石麦, I cannot remember which bag I bought last time but my neighbor老王 got 500 jin per mu with his, so I do the same.

Base fertilizer I put before ploughing — 1 bag of compound 15-15-15 per mu, that is 50 jin a mu. For 9 mu I need 9 bags, about 450 jin. Then at 返青 (green-up) in March I broadcast urea, about 30 jin a mu, maybe 4 bags for the whole field. If the wheat looks yellow I add a bit more — better too much than too little, a thin wheat is a dead wheat.

Irrigation: I water 4 times with the well — winter water before freeze, green-up water, jointing water, grain-fill water. Without water in this dry plain you get nothing.

Pesticide: I spray twice — once for weeds in spring with 2甲4氯, once at heading for aphids and 赤霉病 (head blight). Sometimes three if the bugs are bad.

I use the rotary tiller (旋耕机) — hire the man with the machine, 40 yuan a mu. My body cannot plough anymore.

I expect 500 jin per mu — 250 kg.

**For my maize (9 mu, summer):**

Right after wheat harvest in June, no time to rest. I sow hybrid maize — 郑单958 or 登海, whichever the shop has, I buy 2 jin of seed per mu. All the young people use the sowing machine direct into the wheat stubble — no ploughing. This is called 免耕 (no-till), I was suspicious at first but it works and saves money.

Fertilizer at sowing — 1 bag compound per mu again, 50 jin. Then at the knee-high stage (大喇叭口) I put urea, about 40 jin a mu because maize eats more nitrogen than wheat. That is maybe 5-6 bags of urea for 9 mu.

Irrigation: if the rains come I do not water. Usually I water once or twice with the well — at sowing if dry, and at tasseling. The summer rains usually help.

Pesticide: once for weeds (乙草胺) at sowing, once for 玉米螟 (corn borer) if I see the holes in leaves. Two times.

I expect 1200 jin per mu — 600 kg. Last year I got 1150, year before 1250, so I guess 1200.
